lane_title: Downdip-Lag Hanging-Wall Potential-Field Dipole (+500 m Dip-Vector Shift) x Mesh-Deconfounded (sigma=36 px) MT/Strain/Geothermometer Regime Gate x De-Quantized 1 m LiDAR Scarp + Bilateral LOCO Bridge + Capacity-Capped 300 m Submodular Cover
assignment_note: Self-declared narrow method lane per Protocol Rule 1 (no single method paragraph supplied in the 2026-10-21 brief), directly executing Recommendations 2 and 3 of docs/review-2026-10-21-h77g.md (IR-H77G-01 3.5 km MT mesh notch filtering and IR-H77G-03 hydrothermal-structural coupling) plus untried 500 m downdip hanging-wall potential-field advection and bilateral inter-component LOCO bridge mechanics.
selected_hypothesis: H77H-1 (with H77H-2 mesh-notched hydro-geothermometer regime and H77H-3 Laplace second-vertical-derivative dipole as ablation sub-blocks; H77H-4 EarthScope Vs tomography marked BLOCKED/not viable in sandbox)
physical_mechanism: A 55-60 deg dipping Basin-and-Range normal fault offsets dense pre-Tertiary basement at 500-1000 m depth inside the downthrown hanging wall, displacing the steepest horizontal gradient of isostatic gravity and basement depth by ~400-700 m (+5 px) downdip from the surface scarp breakaway along the local dip unit vector. Pairing this +500 m downdip potential-field dipole with de-quantized 1 m LiDAR / 10 m DEM scarp morphology, a sigma=36 px (3.6 km) mesh-deconfounded MT clay-cap / transtensional / GDR-1391 chemical geothermometer regime gate (fixing IR-H77G-01), and fold-strict Leave-Own-Component-Out (LOCO) bilateral inter-strand bridge continuation isolates both blind/degraded piedmont faults and hydrothermal relay conduits.
named_non_fault_mimic: Gently dipping unfaulted pediment unconformities (Tertiary tuff over Paleozoic basement), Pleistocene Lake Lahontan shoreline scarps above basinward-thickening lacustrine clays, and highway/railroad embankments.
inputs: data/raw/training_features.tif (19 bands; Band 6 treated as TC radiometric total count per IR-77-01; Band 18 treated as signed x-derivative per IR-77-03)
data/raw/external/lidar_scarp_features_u8.tif (1 m USGS 3DEP LiDAR scarp derivatives; q==0 mapped strictly to NaN per IR-77D-01)
data/raw/external/gdr_wellspring_in_footprint.csv and gdr_volcanic_vents_in_footprint.csv (DOE GDR #1391 DOI:10.15121/1881483; dist_known_fault_px strictly forbidden)
data/bridge/existing_faults.tif (strictly restricted to visible training components per fold for LOCO mechanics and visible-fault masking)
data/bridge/sample_submission.tif (used strictly as grid/footprint template; 0 SGMC bedrock channels used)

leakage_canary_gate.metric: single-feature symmetric ROC-AUC max(AUC, 1 - AUC) on withheld positive vs negative footprint pixels
leakage_canary_gate.action_on_exceed: Immediate hard stop before trusting any holdout result

uniqueness_gate.literal_policy_i17: Fail closed (protocol_unique=false, ok_to_submit=false) if any full-footprint dense witness (>70% halo coverage, e.g., ab0a0a62) remains in the literal registry or if the 812-raster REST scan is incomplete.

planned_experiments: E1: Build 12 H77H channels + verify sigma=36 px MT mesh suppression + single-feature ROC-AUC leakage canaries on Seeds 20 and 30 + Phase 1 surface uniqueness check
E2: Dual-seed (Seed 20: 11,321 withheld px; Seed 30: 11,342 withheld px) whole-component buffered hide-and-recover holdout evaluation across 6 arms

E3: Full-map 4-quadrant OOF surface + capacity-capped 300 m submodular dot placement (37,654 dots) + shared submission_writer GeoTIFF/ZIP + 15/15 and 17/17 validator checks + Phase 2 uniqueness audit + run card
